ai_summary: Bank of Baroda announced a change in its Government of India Nominee Director, with Shri Hari Har Mishra, Additional Secretary in the Department of Financial Services, replacing Shri Ashish Madhaorao More, effective October 23, 2026. This is a routine board governance update for a public sector bank. Shri Mishra's extensive 28-year background in financial management, audit, and public administration across various government ministries is a key takeaway, suggesting a strong addition to the board with no apparent red flags or material negative impacts.
